source_basis.cache.c: read_hostsfile emits LOG_ERR for bad address (line 1469) and every non-OOM bad name (line 1532), then LOG_INFO for accepted names (line 1543).
source_basis.dnsmasq.c: EVENT_INIT (line 1575) calls clear_cache_and_reload, whose cache_reload (line 1839) precedes DHCP refresh. The existing owner init barrier now supplies the logger during ordinary hosts loading.
source_basis.memory_design: Hosts::read_from_with_diagnostics invokes the error sink directly. The previous Hosts.read_reports collection was removed; the parser retains its 8192-byte read buffer and 502-byte token buffer. Logger buffering retains its existing bounded behavior.

limitations: The memory experiment uses one legal host plus 48 MiB of short comments. It is not a benchmark of millions of accepted hosts or an invalid-token log flood.
The startup DHCP control checks the first actual REQUEST and authoritative hosts-derived hostname in ordinary and debug mode; it does not enumerate all restored-lease/helper startup histories.
This file closes the three directed F07/streaming commands only. Complete affected-family results and final unit/build qualification are recorded separately.
No physical router experiment or deployment is represented.
